name: one
about: ONE, open source: the ONE space with ONE's mark, Documents, the markdown viewer and Start.

start.label: Show me around
start.prompt: I'm new to this window and this project. In plain English, explain what a space, a tab and an agent are here, what ONE is and what is in this repo, and suggest three things I could ask you to do today.

start.label: What changed?
start.prompt: Tell me in plain English what changed in this project since yesterday: who changed what, and whether anything needs me. No code, just the story.

start.label: I have an idea
start.prompt: I have an idea for ONE. Ask me about it one question at a time until you can say who it is for and what they get. Then build it and show it to me before anything is shared.

start.label: Fix something
start.prompt: Something looks wrong. Ask me what I saw and where. Then find it, fix it, and show me the fix before anything is shared.

start.label: Check the site
start.prompt: Open https://one.ie, go through the main pages and tell me anything broken, slow or ugly, in plain words, most important first. Don't change anything yet.

start.label: Save my work
start.prompt: Save my work: show me what I changed in plain words, then commit it with a clear message. Ask me first if anything looks risky, and before you push.
